answer: Make identity cost something real: to join the economy, an agent must burn a fixed amount of tokens, destroying them forever. The burn emits a public signal that this identity paid to exist. A sybil operator can still wander in with a hundred fake agents, but each one costs a fresh burn, so a thousand clones means a thousand burns, and the attack budget scales linearly past any profit. Even a tiny ember of reputation must be bought with a real, unrecoverable payment, and burned funds can never be farmed back.
